policy.least_work_scope: work_delegation_gate routing is separate gate-owned work only; never export old least-Work policy into primary O.
policy.candidate_identity: Use exact source-qualified identity only; no bare-id, label, prefix/suffix, semantic or fuzzy joins.
policy.decision_dimensions: novelty, evidence strength and decision relevance remain separate.
policy.control_freshness: Each non-exploration invocation: SHA-only main H1 after start; fetch DESIRED_STATE and DOWNSTREAM_STATE at H1; SHA-only H2 immediately before first semantic read; if H1/H2 or relevant revisions differ restart. Freeze tuple after semantic start. Semantic read before guard => bootstrap_valid=false and downstream-ineligible.
policy.bootstrap_validity_contract: Audits/comparators carry bootstrap_valid=true and frozen tuple in receipt/output; integrator rejects/defer missing/false/order-defective provenance.
policy.bridge_freshness: Bridge pins feed to observed main, SHA-only rechecks before mutation, refetches on advance/regression, never regresses feed revision.

o_feed_backlog_control.rule: While O cursor lags, compare against all unacknowledged items by exact source identity/mechanism/question/scope/uncertainty; admit only material incremental information; preserve supersession provenance and distinct decision-relevant items.
o_feed_backlog_control.receipt_requirement: emit metrics on every integrator run.

downstream_wave_protocol.seal_rule: Seal only after active_wave_source_integrity_contract passes for every required source at one pinned selection snapshot. A valid incomplete wave is immutable.
downstream_wave_protocol.consumer_rule: Comparators use exact ACTIVE_WAVE only. Proven source-invalid wave => diagnostic only until integrator seals a verified superseding wave.
downstream_wave_protocol.integration_rule: Require bootstrap-valid exact-wave novelty/relevance pair with persisted schema3 raw manifest independently read back/digested; evidence may be exact-tuple subset; omitted=not_assessed. Source-invalid, ambiguous/nonmember or persistence-invalid inputs are ineligible.
downstream_wave_protocol.independence_rule: ACTIVE_WAVE is downstream-only; clean explorers never read it.

policy.capacity_invariant: Repository logical enablement and physical execution are distinct. Never describe a physically inactive role as executing. Optimizer may run at most one isolated gate-owned fallback only while gate physical role is inactive, respecting gate ownership/idempotency/write isolation.

candidate_identity_contract.authoritative_identity_row: Persist exactly [namespace,source_artifact_blob,source_local_candidate_id]; these three strings are the only identity authority.
candidate_identity_contract.canonical_candidate_key: Derived only as sha256(UTF8(compact_JSON(row,ensure_ascii=false))); consumers recompute and ignore stored disagreement.
candidate_identity_contract.candidate_set_digest: sha256 of UTF-8 compact JSON of ordered persisted three-field rows with ensure_ascii=false.
candidate_identity_contract.full_pair_manifest: Novelty/relevance bind to identical immutable ordered raw manifest/blob/count/digest; assessments bind by raw row index/tuple.
candidate_identity_contract.evidence_subset: Every evidence row carries exact three-field tuple and must be exact member of full-pair manifest; omitted candidates are not_assessed.
candidate_identity_contract.recompute_boundary: Build current-wave tuples from exact sealed source artifact/blob/local id; never inherit predecessor keys/tuples/labels.
candidate_identity_contract.publication_self_audit: After raw manifest write, refetch exact blob, parse each exactly-three-string row, recompute count/digest and bind pair eligibility to persisted rows.
candidate_identity_contract.schema2_compatibility: Schema2 four-field manifests are historical only; key/row disagreement => integration-ineligible and normalize to schema3 without semantic reassessment, never fuzzy-repair.
candidate_identity_contract.normalization_reissue: Unchanged semantics may issue immutable schema3 identity normalization with semantic_reassessment=false, provenance, persisted-byte validation and pointer convergence.

pair_pointer_publication_contract.publication_complete_rule: Final pair complete only when both LATEST pointers read back to same wave/active-wave blob/raw-manifest blob/digest/count/immutable semantic blobs.
pair_pointer_publication_contract.producer_repair_rule: Existing valid exact-wave pair + stale/missing pointer => bounded pointer-only CAS/readback repair, no semantic redo.
pair_pointer_publication_contract.consumer_stale_pointer_rule: Evidence must not infer pair absence from stale LATEST if exact current-wave receipt/artifacts prove pair exists; stop pre-pair semantic expansion and normalize membership mechanically.
pair_pointer_publication_contract.anti_duplication_rule: Once valid pair exists, no further pre-pair evidence expansion unless pair is concretely invalidated.
pair_pointer_publication_contract.readback_requirement: Pointer repair is consumable only after both pointers mechanically read back equal to pair.

lossless_feed_publication_contract.lossless_input_rule: Fetch exact current feed blob and complete UTF-8 JSON; presentation truncation is not unavailability—use exact blob/raw/scrollable surfaces.
lossless_feed_publication_contract.authority_rule: Exact parsed current feed blob is sole rewrite baseline; never rebuild history from summaries/snippets/receipts/memory/index/candidate ids.
lossless_feed_publication_contract.retention_rule: Preserve all acknowledged items structurally except explicit source-qualified supersession/compaction. Cursor==feed and zero unacked does not permit dropping history.
lossless_feed_publication_contract.admission_rule: Admit only exact bootstrap-valid triplet decisions that satisfy backlog/incremental policy; defer only candidates lacking exact data.
lossless_feed_publication_contract.staged_blob_materialization_rule: When direct serializer binding is absent but complete baseline exists, construct replacement only from parsed baseline+allowed changes, create unreferenced Git blob, refetch/parse it, prove retained deep equality, admission accuracy, metrics/revision/digest before any ref mutation.
lossless_feed_publication_contract.content_addressed_roundtrip_rule: Unchanged baseline restaging must reproduce same Git blob SHA; otherwise abort before ref mutation.
lossless_feed_publication_contract.writer_rule: After staged audit, fresh SHA-only main and feed-blob CAS; prefer tree/commit + non-force ref update using audited blob; never publish partial validation.
lossless_feed_publication_contract.readback_rule: After write, refetch exact feed blob/full body and verify digest, retained deep equality, supersessions, admissions, revision and metrics before durable completion.
lossless_feed_publication_contract.defer_rule: Defer if full baseline, exact admission data, staged validation, CAS or full readback cannot be proven; truncation/direct-serializer absence alone is not repeated-defer justification.

active_wave_source_integrity_contract.purpose: Prevent sealing source refs consumers cannot resolve exactly and recover a mechanically proven invalid incomplete seal without semantic reinterpretation.
active_wave_source_integrity_contract.seal_preflight_rule: Pin selection_snapshot_note_main_sha. For every required clean namespace resolve exactly one role-local pointer/checkpoint at that snapshot; fetch selected path at that snapshot and declared Git blob. Require path exists, path blob == declared blob, blob reachable, and pointer-embedded path/blob matches. Never guess/synthesize refs from receipts, labels, newest filenames, stale state or other namespaces.
active_wave_source_integrity_contract.all_source_gate: All required rows must pass before ACTIVE_WAVE write. Compute source_set_digest only from verified persisted selection rows. After write refetch ACTIVE_WAVE and revalidate every row against same snapshot; source_integrity_valid=true required.
active_wave_source_integrity_contract.failed_preflight_rule: Any absent/unreachable/mismatched/ambiguous/unprovable row => do not seal; preserve prior valid coordinator state, emit immutable integrator diagnostic, retry later with fresh control/snapshot.
active_wave_source_integrity_contract.existing_invalid_wave_repair_rule: If an incomplete sealed wave is independently proven source-invalid by exact path/blob mismatch/unreachability while control-source blob fetch proves transport works, integrator alone may suspend ordinary incomplete-wave immutability for one mechanical quarantine/supersession transaction: persist immutable invalid-wave diagnostic binding old wave/blob/digest/failures; never integrate or semantically reinterpret it; at fresh snapshot resolve and preflight all exact current role-local artifacts; generate new wave id/digest; write ACTIVE_WAVE with supersedes_invalid_wave provenance. Never swap rows under old wave id.
active_wave_source_integrity_contract.consumer_rule: Consumers on source-invalid wave emit diagnostic/provenance only; semantic pair/evidence is ineligible until verified superseding wave.
active_wave_source_integrity_contract.receipt_requirement: Every seal/repair receipt records selection snapshot, active-wave before/after blob, per-source namespace/path/blob/path_exists/blob_reachable/pointer_match, source_integrity_valid, digest recomputation, postwrite wave readback and postwrite source revalidation.
active_wave_source_integrity_contract.current_repair_target: If C23 clean-g1-wave-c23-20260827T220339JST-2ef9e73d remains current and its five independently reported unreachable source refs remain invalid, integrator must quarantine/supersede it before semantic comparator work.

durable_execution_receipt_contract.state_changing_downstream_rule: Any downstream invocation changing ACTIVE_WAVE/integration/index/feed/coordinator state must persist immutable own receipt before durable-complete claim, binding frozen tuple, exact inputs, mutations, resulting commit/blob/readback, backlog metrics, termination and next action.
durable_execution_receipt_contract.receipt_gap_rule: If valid transition exists without receipt, preserve transition, mark receipt_gap, do not roll back merely to manufacture receipt; mechanically diagnose gap before next state-changing transition and enforce receipt barrier.

migration.reason: C23 was sealed with multiple exact source path/blob references later shown unresolvable/inconsistent while exact control/source blob fetching worked. Control22 had no mandatory all-source reachability preflight and no safe coordinator recovery for an already-invalid incomplete seal. Control23 makes source reachability a pre/post-seal invariant and permits only mechanical quarantine/supersession under a new wave id.
migration.rollback: Restore blob 8e2a3d... only if exact preflight blocks a valid seal solely because connector verification contradicts independently proven reachable refs. Never restore guessed/stale refs, same-wave substitution, fuzzy identity, lossy feed writes, CLEAN leaks or duplicate O writing.

primary_source_verifier.policy: Complete current-run two-check SHA-only presemantic freshness guard before any clean/public semantic read. Invalid guard => diagnostic only. Otherwise verify high-value clean claims against primary sources with exact source-qualified scope and no worker steering; rotate under-audited namespaces; separate unverified from contradicted; carry frozen tuple.

reproducibility_auditor.policy: Complete current-run two-check SHA-only presemantic guard before clean/audit/repository/public semantic reads. Invalid guard => diagnostic only. Audit implementation/reproduction evidence for high-value clean candidates, prioritizing exact ACTIVE_WAVE/feed when useful; distinguish claim, official support, independent reproduction/failure, missing dependencies/config and O-specific adaptation; exact scope only; no explorer steering/feedback; carry frozen tuple.

o_novelty_comparator.policy: Complete fresh two-check SHA-only presemantic guard. Verify every ACTIVE_WAVE source row exactly under active_wave_source_integrity_contract before semantic evaluation; source-invalid => diagnostic only. Otherwise publish immutable bootstrap-valid novelty/relevance pair under schema3 raw identity manifest/readback/digest; never modify O or explorer feedback.

evidence_comparator.policy: Complete two-check presemantic guard and verify ACTIVE_WAVE source integrity first; source-invalid => diagnostic only. Otherwise assess exact wave selectively and bind each eligible evidence row to exact three-field tuple membership; omitted=no inference; no fuzzy alias or explorer writes.

integrator.receipt_gap_recovery: Before the next state-changing integration after observing a missing prior receipt, emit or persist a mechanical gap diagnostic that binds the prior immutable integration artifact and current coordinator state; never mutate the already-valid prior integration solely to fill observability.
integrator.policy: Complete presemantic guard. Sole ACTIVE_WAVE coordinator. Apply active_wave_source_integrity_contract before every seal and after readback. Valid incomplete wave immutable; proven source-invalid incomplete wave only quarantine/supersede under new fully preflighted wave id with provenance, never repair in place or semantically interpret. If C23 remains invalid, perform mechanical supersession before comparator semantics. Enforce schema3 exact raw-manifest/evidence tuple validation, backlog control, durable receipt barrier and lossless_feed_publication_contract schema2.

bridge.policy: Bridge only clean O_FEED at safe O boundary; no extra Work solely for polling, no individual item spam, preserve exact revision/digest/blob acknowledgement and CAS/readback. Fresh O owner suppresses recovery/duplicate writing; never import work_delegation_gate policy into primary O; use SHA-only control/feed freshness and never regress feed revision.

work_delegation_gate.policy: ACTIVE BOUNDED SUPPORT. Freeze fresh root/downstream/config then execute exactly one highest-priority uncompleted gate-owned task. Direct reasoning/tools/APIs/automations/repository first; Work only if task explicitly allows and remains separate from primary O. Never export old least-Work policy to primary O, become a second O writer, or interrupt frozen O. Gate-local writes only with CAS/idempotency. Empty queue => one bounded nonduplicative optimizer maintenance/integrity unit, not logical no-op. Optimizer fallback is allowed only while physical gate inactive and saturated; fail closed on stale control/authority collision/duplicate key/cross-role write.

automation_optimizer.policy: Optimize managed repo behavior from durable execution evidence; sole aggregate-ledger reconciler; never self-disable. Preserve CLEAN independence/exact scope/O single-writer/fence/CAS/valid-wave immutability/backlog/gate isolation. Detect stale bootstrap, contamination, duplication, stalls, identity/pointer/feed and ACTIVE_WAVE source-ref defects. Require exact per-source seal preflight and mechanical new-wave supersession for proven invalid incomplete waves. Reallocate physical capacity only from measured marginal value.
